# dusk-curves fixtures v1: rkyv archives of G1Affine and G2Affine under the
# dusk backend, with dusk-bls12_381 0.16. Never change an entry; new behaviour
# gets a new version directory.
#
# <group> <structural> <semantic> <name> <hex input>
#
# The input is the point's to_raw_bytes(): the Montgomery limbs of x, then y,
# then the identity byte. The archive holds these bytes followed by padding.
# structural  rkyv-impl alone checks canonical limbs and a 0 or 1 identity byte
# semantic    dusk-bls12_381/rkyv-semantic-validation also checks the curve,
#             the subgroup and that the identity is (0, 1)
#
# The blst backend archives compressed encodings: its outcomes are the checked
# column of the compressed entries in points.txt.
